title: A Bakery for the Garden
author: Mirabel Brightwater
blurb: Paloma Underhill, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
